player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ SimpleTak.
Wɔ board no so, wo stones no pɛ sɛ '{player_stone}' na wo opponent no stones no pɛ sɛ '{opponent_stone}'.

Wɔ wo turn, wo nsenkyerɛ empty cell baako (ne numbered index) na wo de wo stone no sie hɔ.
Sɛ nhwɛ, '[12]' de wo stone no sie cell 12.

Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛyɛ wo stones no mu continuous path a ɛbɛka board no opposite edges baako (soro-aseɛ anaasɛ benkum-nifa).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Akwantu no mu a enni adwuma
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Seli din a ɛnyɛ pɛ {cell_num}. Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛfiri 0 kɔsi {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Ntamadan {cell_num} no wɔ hɔ dedaw. Yi ntamadan a ɛnni hwee.

action.placement: Ɔdane {current_player_id} de ne ho ma ({symbol}) wɔ seli {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Odwumfo {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') kɔɔ dwumadibea mmienu a ɛne emu da!
outcome.draw: Adaka no so ayɛ ma. Ɛte sɛ nea wɔapere!
